about: The write-up's twins, asserted on both sides: the page's (ai/summaryText.ts transcriptPieces, format/prompt.ts recordingSummaryBudget and recordingNotesBudget, capture/markdown.ts withTranscript and withoutTranscript) in ai/writeUpTwins.test.ts, and Rust's (transcript.rs pieces, with_transcript and without_transcript, write_up.rs summary_budget and notes_budget) in their own tests. A piece's text is given by a unit repeated, and its answer by each piece's length in characters. Every transcript here is over the one-pass length, where the two sides split alike.

pieces.name: paragraphs, each short
pieces.unit: We agreed to ship the launch in March and Sam will send the press list on Friday.

pieces.name: one long paragraph of sentences
pieces.unit: This is one sentence of a very long monologue with no pause in it.
